notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

- Fixed an interface display issue related to high resolutions

- For the Great Deaf and his heirs, only text names will be allowed, limited to 12 characters, because no one can have a name longer than Aquasplendere

- In case of force majeure, ships will be able to pass through the Temple of Aquasplendere if there is no other way

- Added additional information about the plot type in the Great Whisperer's bubble when hovering over a small infrastructure

- Right-clicking on infrastructure statuettes will no longer make a sound

- The "Destroy Infrastructure" button should no longer select plots below

- Fixed a bug that caused the Great Whisperer's bubble to flash when hovering over it in addition to hovering over a plot

- Hovering over a plot where a ship was located while choosing the waterfall for the future Temple will no longer display information about it

- Fixed a display bug for the minimum number of waterfalls mission on the future level

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after destroying a Priority Housing

- Shifted the Great Eye tutorial regarding the Tutoring age restriction to the next level



Have a nice day or evening.

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!


Gameplay
- Fixed a bug with waterfalls so that they wouldn't stagnate on their own, without a water connection

- Hovering over an interface cancels the selection of the last infrastructure hovered over, avoiding opening an unwanted infrastructure sheet

- The impact of the Great Deaf's ages has been added from the second level instead of the first to facilitate the first Great Choice

- More transactions have been added for large infrastructures because they produce too quickly compared to the supply of materials

- Building an Embankment will remove the water present on the plot if its quantity is less than 1 m3

- Rewritten the descriptive sentence for the Hole (adding a clarification about digging in water)

- Rewritten the descriptive sentence for the Embankment (adding a clarification about stacking them)

- Visual overhaul of the area of ​​influence of an infrastructure
Tutorials
- Tutorial on selecting the next Temple position rewritten

- Tutorial on the People's Anger and its evolution rewritten

- Tutorial on terraforming using the Hole rewritten

- Tutorial on the Great Deaf's ages shifted to the second level

- Tutorial on fire hazards added



Have a good day or evening.

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/07
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



- Fixed a bug that didn't take into account the duration of the first month when loading a game, switching directly to the next month

- Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash if paused before launching the Great Cohort

- Ambient sound now matches music when changing game speed

- Ships update correctly when the map is rotated at 0 game speed

- New change to the area of ​​influence: it now has a relief so it's clearly visible

- The text color of the “Launch Cohort” button on the Cohort sheet has been lightened

- Hovering over the bottom interface should no longer generate Great Whisperer bubbles when hovering over plots

Have a nice day or evening.

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!


Gameplay
- When the game speed is at 0 during the tutorial, it will automatically reset to 0 during the next tutorial

- Improved water flow to prevent a low-level plot near a waterfall from being unirrigated

- Fixed the display of the total amount of materials for an infrastructure in the interface

- Inactive population mission rewritten

- The Great Whisperer's information about plots will now correctly hide when hovering over a sheet

- Fixed an issue where clicking on the cross or + button of the ship construction would select plots

- Minimum amount of materials transportable by a ship has been set to 1 (in order to empty infrastructures correctly in the event of a lack of materials)

- Changing the Import/Export status of a commodity now correctly updates the Great Whisperer's bubble

- Fixed a bug that did not open the Temple sheet linked to a tutorial correctly when loading a game

- Exiting the Pause menu resets the speed selected before pausing

- Display of a "Some ships are stuck" message when ships cannot find their way to an infrastructure

- Fixed a bug that generated ships built on a plot of land instead of a water plot

- Fixed a bug that displayed the same information in the Great Whisperer's bubble when a selected building moved from one valid plot to another

- Fixed a bug that left water-based infrastructures active when they were no longer on the water

- Negative impact of the Sage increased


Visuals
- Added a "Compass Rose" visual where the map is manipulated to help with navigation

- The "Continue" button is grayed out rather than removed if there is no game in progress

- Enlarged the hygrometer visual

- Enlarged several buttons Interface

- Fixed the display of ships when the game is paused, including for ship destruction

- Removed the animation for opening the Great Whisperer's bubble between two consecutive displays for greater fluidity

- Changed the color of the infrastructure influence zone for greater visibility


Sounds
- Fixed ambient sound not playing every time

- The Temple sheet sound now plays correctly

- Added background sound when the game speed is set to 0

- Added sounds when clicking the hygrometer buttons, including hotkeys

- Added a smoother transition sound for the music when changing game speed



Have a nice day or evening.
